Speech synthesis: edge-tts 7.3.1, voice zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural, rate -4%; speech service receives only authored narration text.
Python runtime dependencies: aiohttp 3.14.5, scipy (preinstalled), numpy (preinstalled), edge-tts transitive packages installed under /workspace/site-packages.
Media tools: ffmpeg/ffprobe (system provided), libx264, libass subtitles.
Synthesis uses HTTPS_PROXY from the environment, passed explicitly to edge-tts. No video or source audio was sent to any external service.
Subtitle font: Noto Sans SC variable TTF from the Google Fonts repository (SIL Open Font License), bundled in fonts/NotoSansSC.ttf.
